cases.name: etaf-posframe-rejects-invalid-options
cases.purpose: Unknown options, non-positive sizes, unsupported dismissal and anchors signal etaf-posframe-error with the offending option named.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-theme-returns-frame-colors
cases.purpose: A panel Theme derives every catalog token as an #RRGGBB color from the current frame.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-live-p-rejects-non-panels
cases.purpose: Lifecycle predicates accept only live panel objects and an empty panel list reports no panels.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-show-owns-panel-lifecycle
cases.purpose: Showing a View mounts one panel and hiding it releases the panel, its Runtime and its frame.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-toggle-hides-the-open-panel
cases.purpose: The toggle entry hides the current buffer's open panel instead of stacking a second one.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-show-replaces-the-buffer-panel
cases.purpose: A second show for the same buffer replaces the earlier panel instead of stacking two.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-timeout-closes-the-panel
cases.purpose: A panel with :timeout hides by itself and releases its Runtime.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-focusable-panel-takes-and-restores-focus
cases.purpose: A focusable panel selects itself on open and returns focus to the previous frame on hide.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-killing-the-parent-buffer-closes-the-panel
cases.purpose: The panel owns a kill-buffer hook in its parent buffer, so killing that buffer releases the panel.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-frame-is-as-wide-as-the-canvas
cases.purpose: A panel frame is exactly as wide as its content columns, so no empty frame is left beside the canvas.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-frame-is-not-taller-than-the-content
cases.purpose: A one-line panel fits its frame and leaves no empty rows below the rendered content.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-header-bar-paints-the-full-width
cases.purpose: The title bar covers every panel column and keeps the panel's own palette in a theme whose header line is inverted.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-frame-follows-an-outside-resize
cases.purpose: A frame resized from outside becomes the panel width: the canvas and the title bar re-lay out at it and a later re-fit keeps it.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-frame-adopts-a-shorter-height
cases.purpose: A frame shortened below the rendered content becomes the new row budget, so a panel clips instead of growing back.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-panel-prints-without-recursing
cases.purpose: Printing a returned panel terminates, so evaluating an etaf-posframe-show call in a buffer cannot loop until memory runs out.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-panels-coexist-by-key
cases.purpose: Two panels with different keys stay open at the same time and hiding one leaves the other alive.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-show-replaces-the-same-key
cases.purpose: Showing a view again under the same key replaces only that panel, not the panels of other keys.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-toggle-targets-its-key
cases.purpose: Toggle hides the panel of its own key and leaves the panels of other keys open.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-anchors-place-panels-in-the-grid
cases.purpose: Frame and window anchors place a panel at the named corner, edge centre or centre of their rectangle.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-cell-places-a-panel-at-character-cells
cases.purpose: A :cell pair places the panel at the same character cell regardless of the panel size.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-rejects-a-bad-cell
cases.purpose: A :cell that is not a pair of non-negative integers signals etaf-posframe-error naming the option.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-panel-opened-in-a-panel-is-independent
cases.purpose: A panel shown while another panel has focus belongs to the underlying buffer and survives that first panel.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-hiding-a-focused-panel-returns-focus
cases.purpose: Hiding a focused panel selects the frame it came from and a panel can be opened again immediately.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-stacks-panels-at-the-same-anchor
cases.purpose: Panels shown at one anchored place are stacked a gap apart at the same x, down to the last opened.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-draws-a-theme-bordered-panel
cases.purpose: A panel paints the requested border colour outside its text area, so the content keeps its exact width.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-rejects-stack-without-an-anchor
cases.purpose: :stack with a cell or a pixel position signals etaf-posframe-error instead of silently ignoring it.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-registered-apps-open-with-one-call
cases.purpose: Two registered applications open in their own panels with one call each, keep their shortcut keys and close independently.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-cycle-walks-panels-and-back
cases.purpose: Cycling moves focus through the open panels in order and returns to the frame behind them.
